sections.name: settings
sections.notes: All active settings emitted by the current Smithproxy saver are typed and editable. HTTP API and webhook identities, endpoints, bind targets, administration identity, filesystem paths, credentials, API keys, syslog targets, filename components, and rating keys use write-only replace/clear controls. Deprecated thread-spray tuning keys are accepted and ignored by Smithproxy and are intentionally not exposed.

sections.name: debug
sections.notes: Global debug flags and the current per-module boolean, integer, and bounded string logging overrides are typed and editable. Module names are constrained to draft-path-safe identifiers.

sections.name: address_objects
sections.notes: CIDR and FQDN address objects are represented by typed edit and structural create drawers. Confirmed structural deletion is available only for unreferenced objects without pending field edits. Structural operations remain capability-gated on stable entity IDs.

sections.name: port_objects
sections.notes: Port ranges are represented by typed edit and structural create drawers. Creation validates ascending bounded ranges; confirmed deletion is limited to unreferenced objects without pending field edits. Structural operations remain capability-gated on stable entity IDs.

sections.name: proto_objects
sections.notes: Protocol identifiers are represented by typed edit and structural create drawers. Creation validates unique protocol numbers; confirmed deletion is limited to unreferenced objects without pending field edits. Structural operations remain capability-gated on stable entity IDs.

sections.name: detection_profiles
sections.notes: All active fields emitted by the current detection-profile saver are typed and editable. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.

sections.name: captures
sections.notes: All active capture fields are typed and editable. Paths, filename components, destination addresses, and interface names use write-only replace/clear controls and remain redacted in draft responses.

sections.name: content_profiles
sections.notes: Content controls and nested rule action metadata are typed. Session filters and rule match/replacement expressions remain server-side and use write-only rotation. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion. Nested rules support ordered structural creation, confirmed deletion, and first/before/last moves when the reviewed structural capability is available. Accepted write-only create values are cleared from the editor and must be re-entered before updating a pending create operation.

sections.name: tls_ca
sections.notes: Authority names and path posture are exposed; filesystem paths support write-only replace or clear and never reach the browser.

sections.name: tls_profiles
sections.notes: All active fields saved by the current Smithproxy TLS profile schema are typed. SNI bypass expressions support write-only replace or clear and never cross the browser boundary. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.

sections.name: ssh_profiles
sections.notes: All active SSH profile fields are typed and editable; host-key paths are write-only and remain redacted. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.

sections.name: alg_dns_profiles
sections.notes: The current DNS ALG profile schema is represented by the typed editor. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.

sections.name: routing
sections.notes: All active fields emitted by the current routing-profile saver are typed and editable. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.

sections.name: policy
sections.notes: All fields currently returned by the policy snapshot contract are represented by typed edit and ordered structural create drawers. Existing policies support optimistic first, before, and last move operations; restoring the original position removes the pending move. Confirmed structural deletion rejects conflicting pending field edits. Structural operations remain capability-gated on stable entity IDs.

sections.name: starttls_signatures
sections.notes: All active signature metadata and ordered flow controls are typed. Matcher expressions remain server-side and support write-only replacement. Structural add, remove, and reorder semantics are specified in the transaction proposal but remain unavailable until the reviewed upstream capability exists.

sections.name: detection_signatures
sections.notes: All active signature metadata and ordered flow controls are typed. Matcher expressions remain server-side and support write-only replacement. Structural add, remove, and reorder semantics are specified in the transaction proposal but remain unavailable until the reviewed upstream capability exists.

sections.name: script_profiles
sections.notes: All active script-profile fields are typed and editable; executable paths are write-only and remain redacted. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.

sections.name: auth_profiles
sections.notes: Authentication posture is typed; identity mappings remain redacted. Stable unreferenced profiles support confirmed structural deletion.
